blockers: agl_ads AglAds.initialize() preloads an interstitial on every launch even if the app never calls onTransition (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ads.dart:94 `unawaited(_loadInterstitial());`). Removing the onTransition call does not stop that request; agl_ads needs an opt-out (e.g. a configure flag) or the app keeps sending one unused interstitial request per launch. v2 removes the onTransition call, so this unused request would remain.
